review:
Aliens and coloured gems on six Megaways reels, with wilds on every reel except the first and tumbles after wins.

The rocket is the star: it turns the symbols it lands on into wilds that lock, nudge down one spot after each tumble, and add more wilds at the top until the spin ends. That chain can fill the grid with wilds fast. Four scatters trigger free spins. 96.01% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
